sources.title: PartiDesign: A structure-sequence co-design paradigm for ... - bioRxiv
sources.snippet: A key challenge is to couple three-dimensional structure generation with sequence or chemical-identity design across chemically diverse systems. Here, we introduce PartiDesign, a unified structure-sequence co-design model that extends the partially latent framework of La-Proteina to proteins, nucleic acids and small molecules.
